note: Work stand and job targets per workplace type. Offsets are logical TILE offsets from the building centre (tile 0 spans 0.0-1.0, tile centres sit at n+0.5). A building of size 2 has its centre on a tile corner, so its ring tile centres are at odd half offsets (+/-0.5, +/-1.5); a size 1 building centres on its own tile, so ring tile centres are at whole offsets (+/-1.0). Every stand is a walkable tile OUTSIDE the footprint, the target is the actual job inside the workplace.
